title: Snow Shoveling Help for Seniors: Book It Before the First Storm
summary: Find snow shoveling help for seniors with GoGoGrandparent. Learn how to arrange snow removal, compare costs, and prepare your home before winter storms.
body_markdown:
Snow shoveling help for seniors is a phone call, and the call should come before the snow does. GoGoGrandparent connects older adults with a local provider who clears the driveway, the walkway and the steps, arranged by phone at1 (855) 464-6872 , no app needed. The part most people get wrong is the timing. Call before the storm so the team has time to check for a provider in your area, because the work is arranged in advance. Here's how it works and when to call.


## **When is it worth getting help with snow shoveling?**


It's worth getting help when the snow is heavy, the steps are slick, or the job feels like more than you want to take on. Shoveling is heavy, cold, hurried work on the slipperiest surface of the year, and one mistake can mean a fall. Wet snow weighs more than it looks, the footing is bad, and the job usually gets done first thing in the morning, before anyone has warmed up. If you've had a fall, a heart problem or a hip or knee replaced, it may be time to hand this one off. The question is who to hand it to.


## **How does GoGo snow removal for seniors work?**


You call, GoGo connects you with a local provider, and our home services team screens the providers. The provider clears the driveway, the walkways and the paths to your door, and the steps, porch and entryway. Salt or ice melt can be spread on the cleared surfaces if you ask for it. You can set up a single visit or a plan for the whole winter.


Here is the sequence:


1. **Call**1 (855) 464-6872 **and press 8** for home services, or press 0 for an operator. If you're new to GoGo, ask the operator how to get started.
2. **Describe the job.** How long the driveway is, whether there are steps, whether you want salt or ice melt, and whether you'd like one visit or a season plan.
3. **The home services team reviews the request** and lets you know what's available in your area and how to get a quote. The quote is based on the size of the area to clear.
4. **If a provider is available and you accept the quote,** the team can arrange the visit or the plan with the provider.


A family member can make the call for you once they have been added to your account as someone who can make requests.


## **When should I book snow removal?**


Before the first storm. Requests are arranged in advance, so call before the first storm to give the team time to review the job and check local provider availability. The week of a forecast storm is when everyone else calls too.


Ask the operator what's possible where you live. If a seasonal plan is offered in your area, ask what it covers and when service is triggered, so you know what to expect before the first snow.


## **What does snow removal cost?**


It depends on the size of the area to clear, so ask for a quote before anything is scheduled. A short walkway and three steps is a different job from a two-car driveway with a sidewalk to keep clear. Ask about a per-visit price and a seasonal plan and see which fits.


## **Are there free snow shoveling programs for seniors?**


Some cities and counties run volunteer or subsidized snow shoveling programs for older residents, often through the senior center or the public works department. Eligibility usually depends on age, income or disability, the programs tend to fill before the first snow, and most ask you to register in the autumn rather than after the storm. It's worth a call to your local senior center. GoGo is the option you can book on your own terms, and the two don't exclude each other.


## **What else helps in a snowy week?**


- **Groceries before the storm.** Order ahead of the storm through GoGo Grocery and ask what delivery times are available. Same number, press 7 for delivery.
- **A ride when conditions allow.** If the roads are unsafe, postpone trips that can wait. When conditions allow, GoGo can help arrange a ride to the ones that can't. Our guide to[winter safety for seniors](https://www.gogograndparent.com/blog/falls-to-flu-9-winter-safety-tips-for-seniors) covers the rest of the season.
- **Grab bars and a railing.** The[home services](https://www.gogograndparent.com/services/home-services-for-seniors) page lists the handyman help that makes the walk to the car safer all winter.


## **Book it this week**


Snow removal for seniors is one call, made before the snow, not after it. Call1 (855) 464-6872 , press 8, describe the driveway, and let the home services team review the job and tell you how to get a quote. The full list of what's included is on the[snow shoveling service](https://www.gogograndparent.com/services/home-services-for-seniors/snow-shoveling-for-seniors) page.


## **FAQ**


### **How far ahead do I need to book snow shoveling with GoGo?**


Call before the first storm, to give the team time to review the job and check local provider availability. Ask whether a seasonal plan is offered where you live and what it covers.


### **Who does the shoveling?**


A local provider GoGo connects you with. Our home services team screens the providers. They are not GoGo employees.


### **Can my daughter or son set this up for me?**


Yes. Once they have been added to your account as someone who can make requests, they can call and arrange it for you.


### **Do I need a smartphone?**


No. The whole thing is arranged by phone at1 (855) 464-6872 , on the number you give the operator.
